title: Still Zack Wheeler: six of the ten best starter seasons by xwOBA since 2015 are his
subtitle: Phillies pitcher-seasons with a starter's workload (≥2,000 regular-season pitches), 2015–2026, n = 41. 2026 (red): xwOBA .263, #6 of 41; K-BB 22.6%, #6. Phillies-only frame (CX-1b), not MLB-wide. xwOBA = XW-1 (PA-denominated).

title: Results: the walk rate is the one line that set a Phillies-tenure high
subtitle: Regular season, 2020–2026, entity-locked to MLBAM 554430. 2026: wOBA .278 (xwOBA .263), OPS .630, K 29.9%, BB 7.3% over 645 PA. BB vs his 2021–25 rate (5.6%): p = 0.09.

title: Zone expansion: fewer strikes thrown than ever, more chases than ever
subtitle: 2026 in-zone 42.1% vs 50.2% in 2021–25 (p < .001); chase 36.2% vs 32.1% (p = 0.002). Edge rate (ER-1, within one baseball of the zone line) held at 36.0% vs 36.9% (p = 0.39). Regular season, Phillies tenure.

title: The walk rate is one six-start stretch, not a season
subtitle: Stretch 7/27–8/24: BB 13.4% (16 in 119 PA) vs 5.9% in his other 22 starts (p = 0.004); 8.51 runs on watch per 27 outs, which reconciles to the reported 8.51 ERA. The finish (8/30–9/27): BB 6.2%, 1.67 runs per 27 outs.

title: The misses moved arm side during the stretch; the release point did not move
subtitle: Arm-side share of clear misses: 25.5% in the stretch vs 17.8% otherwise (p = 0.033). Four-seam release x -1.88 vs -1.83 ft (p = 0.28), height 4.97 vs 5.00 ft (p = 0.31), start means, Welch. Reported cause (a dropped glove, over-rotation) is a carry-in; the log cannot see a glove.

title: Contact quality: nothing moved beyond noise
subtitle: Dotted line = his pooled 2021–25 rate. 2026 vs that baseline: hard-hit 35.2% vs 33.3% (p = 0.46); barrel 6.0% vs 6.4% (p = 0.73); line drive 23.2% vs 23.3% (p = 0.95). 401 balls in play in 2026.

title: Tied-up rate: above the room, not at the top of it
subtitle: Phillies pitcher-seasons 2025–26 with ≥50 tracked swings (JR-1 floor), keyed by MLBAM id, n = 45. Wheeler 2026: 32.0%, #11 of 45; #6 of 14 with ≥500 tracked swings. Leader: Alvarado, José 2026 (44.8%). A public-data proxy for Savant's swing-timing bucket, not Savant's number.

title: Swing timing by pitch: the sinker ties up righties
subtitle: ST-1 buckets of tracked swings, 2026: tied-up < 32.5 in (JR-1) · centered 32.5–41 in · flail > 41 in (provisional, the client's histogram line). Sinker vs RHB: 124 tied-up swings, 55 in play, 14 hits, 75.8 mph average EV, 56% grounders.

title: Platoon: lefties did more damage, and it shows in contact quality
subtitle: 2026 vs LHB: wOBA .304 / xwOBA .287 over 379 PA; vs RHB .242 / .229 over 266 PA. Hard-hit 41.9% vs 25.7% (p = 0.001). Marker size = PA. The gap was wider in 2024 (.118 wOBA).

title: Pitch map: where each pitch lives, by batter side (2026)
subtitle: Average location (PM-1 centroid, unrounded) of each pitch type; marker size = share of that side's pitches. Shaded box = rulebook zone at his average zone (1.62–3.21 ft). 2,649 regular-season pitches.

title: Pitch plot: the splitter became his second pitch
subtitle: Every 2026 regular-season pitch (pfx × 12); large markers = pitch-type means. Splitter usage 8.9% → 16.3%, whiff 45.5%. Sinker whiff 10.8% (lowest of the six). Four-seam 95.2 mph (2025: 96.1).

title: The Still-Wheeler card: what 2027 has to look like, written down first
subtitle: OC-1 rule (uc-pps-034), second use: a start is ON-SCRIPT when ≥3 of 4 hold. Bars = his 2026 starts at the 25th percentile (75th for walks); registered 2026-10-12, before any 2027 pitch. Backtest: on-script starts 20 (2.16 runs per 27 outs), off-script 8 (4.96); the finish 6/6. Wild Card G3 relief, graded after the fact: OFF-SCRIPT.

title: Zack Wheeler, 2026: 28 starts, 162.0 IP, 193 K, xwOBA .263
subtitle: Six of the ten best Phillies starter seasons by xwOBA since 2015 are his. The red bars are the six-start stretch (7/27–8/24, 13.4% walks); the navy bars are the finish (1.67 runs per 27 outs). Still Zack Wheeler.
